gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Commanding up top, Wallpoet is a stencil-cut display face that earns its keep big and brief. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono follows in a stretched-out, typewriter-ish sans-serif, its spacing bridging wide gaps between the letters.
Heavy stencil gaps, loud and sharp. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Next gives the paragraphs big open lowercase eyes and unlatched rounds, so a long page of sans-serif text keeps moving without snagging.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-biryani: Stencil swagger with lowercase that towers. Wallpoet earns its keep big and short, while Biryani's sans-serif body draws every line at fixed pressure, its large e eyes and small counters staying clear.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-blinker: Bold, almost shouting, the heading sets the tone with its split stencil lines. Blinker's plain sans text holds its line width through every turn, so you can size it up a notch for easy reading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-carrois-gothic: Wallpoet drives the heading with a smooth, high-rising stencil look. Carrois Gothic takes over below with a tall x-height and generously opened c, so a long passage reads in a modern, tidy sans.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC reads as a plain sans with little gap between capital and lowercase heights, and open curve endings. Wallpoet looms above it, so give the body a little extra size.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-chivo: Wallpoet comes in loud, stencil-cut and tall. Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the caps, with daylight through each curve, so a long passage in this plain sans goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-chocolate-classical-s: Stencil punch, split lines, high-reaching lowercase. Chocolate Classical Sans plays it as a sizable sans with broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut, so try it at a generous size.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-comme: Loud stencil lines with towering lowercase up top. Comme settles below as a plain sans with big lowercase bodies and unclogged curves, so a long passage glides along.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-cossette-texte: Loud, stencil-split and tall, the heading grabs first. Cossette Texte replies in a plain sans with tube-smooth lines and a prominent x-height, so the page moves from shout to easy reading.
